test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: MUDRA refers to ___________

options.text: Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency
Medium Units Developed and Refinance Association
Micro Units Developing and Regulatory Agency

solution:
The correct answer is __**Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Micro** stands for micro enterprises, which are the primary focus of the MUDRA (Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency) Yojana.
 
• MUDRA Yojana **was launched by the Government of India to provide funding to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.**
 
• **The scheme aims to support the growth and development of micro-enterprises in India by providing financial assistance up to Rs. 10 lak**h.
 
• MUDRA loans are categorized into three products: Shishu (covering loans up to Rs. 50,000), Kishor (covering loans above Rs. 50,000 and up to Rs. 5 lakh), and Tarun (covering loans above Rs. 5 lakh and up to Rs. 10 lakh).
 
• The **initiative is aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and employment generation at the grassroots level.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MUDRA Bank** was established as a subsidiary of SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India).
 
• The scheme also focuses on providing financial literacy and credit counseling to micro-entrepreneurs.
 
• MUDRA Yojana is part of the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY), which was launched on 8th April 2015.
 
• It aims to achieve financial inclusion by extending credit to micro-businesses, which often face difficulties in accessing formal banking channels.
 
• The scheme has been instrumental in empowering women entrepreneurs and promoting inclusive growth.
